const f = (x: number): number => x;
console.log(f.call(null, 'str'));
console.log(f.apply(null, ['str']));
console.log(f.bind(null, 'str')());
const g = (x: number, y: number): number => x + y;
console.log(g.call(null, 1));
console.log(g.call(null, 1, 2, 3));
class C {
  m(s: string): string { return s; }
}
console.log(new C().m.call(new C(), 5));
console.log(g.bind(null, 1)('a'));
console.log(g.apply(null, [1]));
function k(this: { n: number }, d: number): number { return this.n + d; }
console.log(k.call({ n: "x" }, 1));
class P { constructor(public x: number) {} }
console.log(P.bind(null, 'a'));
